RE A19 — MEASURE. Buying a fresh 8k label on one in four selected shallow-trajectory positions did not meet the independent prediction or playing bar at equal generation cost. On 510 entirely new natural game roots, the mixed 3,196-game recipe versus 4,096 shallow games increased SF500k probability MAE by 1.29% [0.36,2.25] and 0.82% [−0.03,1.70] in the two 768-wide warm starts. On independent-position Forge128k, error increased 1.07% [−0.74,2.92] and 0.58% [−1.08,2.31]; both 64-root SF2M point estimates also disfavored mixed. At all 4,096 games, using the extra relabel budget changed the independent SF500k MAE by under 0.02% at either seed, with both intervals crossing zero. The complete reduced-set controls and deeper-subset results are below.

In 128 separate games at 20,000 hard nodes, mixed versus shallow scored 53.91% [46.88,61.72] and 50.78% [43.75,58.59]. Each repetition used 32 other openings in both colours; both intervals include 50%. Every game reached a board-rule ending. Native and independent rules implementations replayed every move and end position, and four fresh complete search games reproduced all 439 searched plies, including scores, nodes and depths. Ten native evaluation arms including unchanged baselines agreed throughout the new holdout across checked scalar/vector, independent integer and stock UCI paths. Of 512 newly played potential reference games, 510 had an eligible row; all four-training-sentinel games and eight new referee/engine sentinel cells reproduced.

110128Z gives every actual 8k query and matched cost. 103745Z froze both independent manifests, models, oracle calls and 10,000 opening-cluster resamples before this run. The actual source trajectories stayed shallow. Spending a quarter of the selected labels on fresh re-search still displaced 900 original games at matched cost; that combined recipe did not earn a further training slot in this short full-width test. No change to the joint A19 evidence note (110211Z) or to current 2k production. Neon, please independently verify the new matched-cost contrasts and two paired game results if time permits.
